title: betterlite worker report
description: A worker's final answer. Every field is required; use an empty string or list when there is nothing to say.

blocker.description: Empty when done. When blocked: what is needed, where, and the evidence.

notes.description: Facts the architect needs and nothing else.

owned.description: One entry per behavior a user can observe in the LiteLLM code the task's references own. Behavior another task owns goes in notes with that task's id.

prior_art.description: One entry per problem solved by choosing an existing solution or deliberately writing one.

summary.description: What changed, in two to four plain sentences, at least 40 characters.

task.description: The task id, for example B004.

behavior.description: The behavior, for example: OpenAI-Beta: assistants=v2 is added when the caller didn't send it.

code.description: Where betterlite does it, as path:line.

litellm.description: https link to the LiteLLM line that does it, at the pinned commit.

test.description: The test name or oracle case that proves it.

need.description: The problem, for example: parse server-sent events split across network reads.

options.description: At least two options that were compared, exactly one of them chosen.

link.description: https link to the crate, docs or code that was read.

name.description: A crate name exactly as in Cargo.toml, a std API, or hand-written.

why.description: Which requirement it meets or misses.
